title: Abstraction
description: Domain-neutral structural description of a problem (user input) or of a paper (corpus). Same schema for both. LOCKED at Hour 2.

functional_problem.description: One sentence stating the abstract problem or phenomenon, with no domain nouns (no field-specific objects, materials, organisms, or institutions).

constraints.description: Domain-neutral conditions the solution must satisfy.

mechanism.description: One sentence: the principle by which the work solves or explains the problem, in domain-neutral terms. Corpus papers: REQUIRED (the batch job retries on null). User input: null when the user has not proposed an approach.

domain_tags.description: The source domain vocabulary that was stripped out. Used for display only, never for matching.
